notes.title: ABODE 2 is out!
notes.notes:
Abode 2 is finally here, we were super happy to make a sequel and returning to abode was a delight. 

We put a lot of love and effort into this game and really hope you'll enjoy it! 

check it out here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147970/Abode_2/

[previewyoutube=gzeBo7dbozY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Abode 2 Coming soon!
notes.notes:
A sequel
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28488099/8b31ab4838b6dfd1069f8a8c6b4498fd67f7cfc4.png[/img]

We're super excited to announce that Abode 2 is coming at the end of October.

The steam site is up now so check it out and add it to your wishlist.

Abode was an amazing game to make so we really felt like we wanted to take that concept and bring it up a notch, we really feel like we managed to keep the essence of abode while also adding a lot to it.
It's also our first sequel which is pretty awesome.


Stay tuned for more updates and the gameplay trailer, coming soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28488099/dde1ace5bb2d19778701aa29383b3a129edd664f.png[/img]

All the best
Jon & sam at overflow.

notes.title: NEW GAME - STAR SHELTER
notes.notes:
Star shelter is a little jump in Genre for us but we wanted to try something bigger, Star shelter is releasing next week so stay tuned if you wanna know more. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/698260/Star_Shelter/


We're still working hard to maintain and fix any bugs with conductor as well. (we're a 2 man team so our resources are limited)
so just let us know if you're having issues, and we'll fix those as soon as possible.

Cheers!

notes.title: Some overdue updates
notes.notes:
Sorry for the delay , we've been working hard on the next game.

Bugs fixes:

  [*]  Key in the bunker couldnt be picked up if glass was broken on save/quit.

  [*]  Rotator tracks could would save position after physics freak out


Added single pass rendering might improve performance for some.

notes.title: Some fixes from early feedback.
notes.notes:
Some minor fixes.

  [*]Added more stars in the sky.
(We considered adding a moon but the pitch black would be weird)

  [*]Fixed Gravity Cannn tutorial. (Some people would press the menu and would never see the tutorial text).

[*] Fixed a typo :P.

[*] Optimized lights in Bridge station.


Please let us know if you find a bug/Issue . Or if you have an idea.


PS. If you haven't already please write a review it really helps.
